label: new Ra (legacy New Sum(Ra), deep valleys limited)
architecture: mil2d_multi (ImageNet ResNet-18 over 9 patches) + relative-error loss, 61 outlier tiles excluded
outputs: output = Ra [um], shape (N, 1); stage_logits = [finishing, roughing, nc] (nc not trained)
preprocess_note: ra_predictor.spot_crop (= the package predict.py = machine_vision prepare_spot_tiles.py): 1100 px square centred on the laser spot found within 300 px of nominal_spot_xy, spot filled with the ring median, centre 900, grey copied to 3 channels, (x/255-0.5)/0.5
scope: UPR die finishing / roughing surfaces, same camera / lighting / spot layout as the training frames; NC surfaces not trained; predictions run ~12 % low (median pred/true 0.88)
